verdict.rationale: Veriff documents reviewing and managing verification sessions manually on the Customer Portal's Verifications page. Statuses a user adds to an attempt there are emitted through a user-defined-statuses webhook, so reviewer actions do feed back into the record. However, nothing shows that borderline sessions are automatically routed into a review queue, or that the reviewer sees the full evidence set. missing for 10: automatic routing of borderline cases to a queue, documented reviewer view of document images, extracted fields and check results, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record
